summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Import Wizard after migration to MariaDB storage. All backend endpoints working correctly with file storage in database (base64 chunks). Frontend Import Wizard page loads and displays correctly. All 22 backend tests passed, frontend smoke test passed.

Backend: POST /api/import/upload - xlsx/xls/csv files stored in MariaDB
Backend: Upload response does NOT include 'path' or 'storage' fields
Backend: POST /api/import/analyze - auto mapping works correctly
Backend: POST /api/import/validate - reads file from DB correctly
Backend: GET /api/import/errors/{session_id}?format=xlsx - error report download
Backend: GET /api/import/errors/{session_id}?format=csv - CSV error report
Backend: POST /api/import/execute - import execution works
Backend: GET /api/import/job/{id} - job status polling works
Backend: GET /api/import/history - import history retrieval
Backend: DELETE /api/import/batch/{id} - rollback works correctly
Backend: Large file >2MB upload (3.1 MB CSV with 15000 rows)
Backend: Multi-chunk storage and reassembly works correctly
Backend: Negative case - .txt file rejected with 422
Backend: Negative case - corrupt xlsx rejected with 422
Backend: Negative case - empty file rejected with 422
Backend: Negative case - unknown session returns 404
Backend: Permission check - petugas can access import endpoints
Backend: Permission check - operator can access import endpoints
Backend: Full workflow test - upload, analyze, validate, execute, rollback
Frontend: Login successful with superadmin credentials
Frontend: Import Wizard page loads at /impor route
Frontend: Page title displays 'Impor Data (Excel / CSV)'
Frontend: File upload input element present
Frontend: Template download button present
Frontend: Import history table displays previous uploads
Frontend: 6-step wizard UI visible (Upload → Mapping → Validasi → Preview → Impor → Selesai)
